i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load the handed-in goal (#391 quali gap scale), the framing brief, glossary, spread_target.py contract, diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py scoring, and §2/§3/§4/§7.6.2/§9. Record pass when loaded.

q1-measure.title: What does 'improve midfield resolution' mean operationally, given a scalar gap scale cannot move ordering KPIs?
q1-measure.imperative: The prediction is consumed as an ordering (-pi, lower=better); rank_mae/sign-acc are ordering metrics. A per-event positive scalar s_e applied to pi differences (expected_gap = s_e*(pi_i-pi_j)) is MONOTONE in pi differences, so it leaves sign-accuracy and rank order INVARIANT by construction. So the acceptance KPI as literally written (does a gap scale improve rank_mae/sign-acc) is provably ~zero. Pin which the Admiral means: (A) the real KPI is a GAP-MAGNITUDE error (predicted-gap vs observed-gap MAE in fraction-of-median units, the natural metric for a magnitude lever) and the honest-null clause applies to the ORDERING KPIs; or (B) something about the mechanism is expected to change ordering (e.g. a learned predict-s_e head whose features also re-weight pi) — which would make it ordering work that belongs to #375, not here.
q1-measure.finding: ADMIRAL RULING (binding) = option (A) tightened. Measurement is GAP-MAGNITUDE error: predicted gap (s_hat_e*(pi_i-pi_j), fraction-of-median units) vs OBSERVED quali gap (compute_pace_gaps), as pairwise gap-MAE + a calibration view, midfield-sliced, OOS. The bar for 'meaningful': the event-conditioned scale must BEAT a global-constant-scale baseline (one s for all events; the comparable_scale status-quo-ante analog) on gap-MAE, OOS; add a second naive baseline (persistence: prior event's s_e) if cheap, but global-constant is the one that must fall. Ordering KPIs (rank_mae/sign-acc/edge-over-persistence) reported as expected-FLAT by design (monotone-invariance: a positive per-event scalar on pi-differences cannot move ordering KPIs -- ALGEBRAIC, not empirical); their flatness is the decoupling evidence; invoke the honest-null clause for them by design. (B) REJECTED: re-weighting pi / changing ordering is #375 territory. Prediction-time distinction respected: s_e is a POST-EVENT label; the mean head must express the gap scale at PREDICTION time (s_hat_e from pre-event features / carried-forward history / calibration -- smallest mechanism, default-preserving flag).

q2-deliverable-type.title: LABEL-side baseline vs PREDICTIVE head — which deliverable?
q2-deliverable-type.imperative: §9: s_e is a POST-EVENT label (sees the event's own laps, like retro pi). Two very different deliverables: (A) a LABEL-SIDE gap baseline — characterize/expose expected_gap = s_e*(pi_i-pi_j) using the label s_e and committed pi, measured against observed quali gaps, as the trustworthy baseline #386 builds on (small, no retrain, no as-of features); or (B) a PREDICTIVE gap scale — fit an as-of feature->s_e map (predict the event scale before the event) and wire it into the mean head (larger, may be retrain-shaped, needs an as-of feature contract). Which is the #391 deliverable?
q2-deliverable-type.finding: RESOLVED (default under ruling, logged): BOTH-but-minimal -- (A) the LABEL-SIDE gap baseline is the #386 contract (pure expected_gap=s*(pi_i-pi_j) over committed pi + label s_e, measured vs observed quali gaps), AND a SMALLEST prediction-time expression for the #391 mean head. The Admiral ruling forbids a fitted as-of feature->s_e map as the default (that is the larger, retrain-shaped (B) and a feature-contract burden). Smallest prediction-time mechanism = CARRY-FORWARD persistence (last-known prior-event quali s_e as s_hat_e) and/or a GLOBAL-CONSTANT calibration -- both pure, no retrain, no new as-of feature pipeline. So deliverable = (i) pure expected_gap module (label-side baseline = #386 contract), (ii) a prediction-time s_hat_e provider that is the smallest mechanism (carry-forward; global-constant is the baseline it must beat), (iii) the OOS midfield gap-MAE measurement of event-conditioned vs global-constant (and persistence) s. A learned feature->s_e head is explicitly DEFERRED (triage candidate), not built here.

q3-baseline-contract.title: What exactly does #386 consume as the 'trustworthy gap baseline', and where?
q3-baseline-contract.imperative: The decoupling deliverable is a baseline #386's 'excess flip risk' measures against. Pin the contract shape: per-event expected gap function expected_gap_ij = s_e_event*(pi_i-pi_j)? a committed artifact, or a module function (e.g. in spread_target.py or a new quali_gap_scale.py)? per-pair or per-event scalar? Does #386 want PREDICTED s_e or the LABEL s_e as its baseline? Recommend: a small pure module exposing expected_gap given (pi, s_e) plus a measured fit-quality report (how well s_e*(pi_i-pi_j) tracks observed quali gaps), label-side, so #386 has a documented contract and number.
q3-baseline-contract.finding: RESOLVED (default, logged): Contract = a small PURE module function expected_gap_ij(pi_i, pi_j, s) = s*(pi_i - pi_j), plus a per-event/per-field convenience expected_gaps(pi_map, s) -> {driver: s*(pi_d - 0)} or pairwise form, located in a NEW module src/evo_predictor/quali_gap_scale.py (keeps spread_target.py = label estimator/IO untouched; new file = the EXPRESSION/consumer lane #391 owns). Scalar is PER-EVENT (one s per event), matching the s_e artifact granularity; pairwise gap derived from it. #386 (Thrust B epic) consumes the LABEL s_e as its baseline (it defines 'excess flip risk beyond what the gap predicts' -- the honest reference gap uses committed pi + the post-event label s_e). #391's mean head expresses the PREDICTED s_hat_e (carry-forward) gap. Both share the SAME expected_gap function (one contract, two s sources). Deliverable also includes the measured fit-quality report: how well s*(pi_i-pi_j) tracks observed quali gaps (gap-MAE + calibration), label-side and prediction-time, OOS midfield. Documented in §9.5 append + the evo_predictor architecture packet so #386 has a cited contract + number.

q4-mechanism.title: Mechanism family: post-hoc per-event scale calibration vs auxiliary s_e head vs conditioning?
q4-mechanism.imperative: Admiral: prefer the smallest mechanism that meets acceptance; the epic rewards default-preserving flags. Given q1/q2 answers, recommend post-hoc per-event scale calibration of the ordinal head's output (multiply pi-differences by s_e to express gaps) as the smallest mechanism — no pi-semantics change, no retrain, behind a default-off flag. Confirm the mechanism and that it must be DEFAULT-PRESERVING (existing ordering output unchanged unless flag set).
q4-mechanism.finding: RESOLVED (default = Admiral-preferred smallest): post-hoc PER-EVENT SCALE EXPRESSION of the ordinal head's output -- multiply committed pi-differences by s_hat_e to express gaps. NO pi-semantics change (pi stays dimensionless ordering; gap via exchange rate only), NO retrain, behind a DEFAULT-PRESERVING flag (existing ordering output -pi is unchanged unless the gap-scale path is explicitly requested). The pure expected_gap module is the mechanism core; the prediction-time s_hat_e = carry-forward last-known quali s_e (smallest); global-constant s is the baseline. No auxiliary learned head, no conditioning (those are #375/(B), out of lane). Confirmed mechanism is additive + opt-in: it adds a gap EXPRESSION the head did not have, leaving every existing consumer of -pi byte-identical.

q5-retrain-budget.title: Confirm no gold-cycle retrain is in budget; bounded fits/inference only.
q5-retrain-budget.imperative: Fleet invariant: a multi-hour gold retrain needs Admiral approval and must STOP. Confirm the deliverable is achievable with bounded fits/calibrations/inference on existing artifacts (committed gold bundle + s_e artifacts + DB), and that if any chosen path turns out to require a retrain, the correct action is to STOP and report rather than launch it.
q5-retrain-budget.finding: RESOLVED (confirmed, logged): NO gold-cycle retrain in budget. Deliverable is fully achievable with bounded pure computation on EXISTING committed artifacts: committed quali s_e artifacts (params/spread_target/<y>/<r>/quali.json, 114 quali records 2021-2025), read-only retro pi (params/retro_truth via retro_loader), and the DB (observed quali gaps via compute_pace_gaps over get_quali_best_valid_laps_batch). The gap-MAE harness is a deterministic script (stdlib + numpy, py, DB + artifacts), ~seconds. No NN inference/training needed: the committed retro pi and committed s_e are the only model-side inputs, both already on disk. If ANY chosen path turns out to require a gold retrain or multi-hour inference, the correct action is STOP and report for Admiral approval -- do NOT launch. Confirmed within the <=10 min/command + FOREGROUND fleet invariants.

consolidation.summary: PROBLEM STATEMENT (#391, reconciled with Admiral ruling). LANE: give the quali MEAN head a gap-MAGNITUDE expression (how far apart drivers are), kept distinct from sigma/ordering. pi stays dimensionless ordering; gap expressed ONLY via per-event exchange rate s: expected_gap_ij = s*(pi_i-pi_j) in fraction-of-median units. MECHANISM (smallest, default-preserving, opt-in): a pure module quali_gap_scale.py exposing expected_gap; the existing -pi ordering output is byte-identical unless the gap path is requested. PREDICTION-TIME s_hat_e = carry-forward last-known prior-event quali s_e (smallest mechanism); a fitted as-of feature->s_e map is DEFERRED (that is (B)/#375-shaped). MEASUREMENT (Admiral option A tightened): pairwise gap-MAE + calibration of predicted gap vs OBSERVED quali gap (compute_pace_gaps), MIDFIELD-sliced, OOS; the event-conditioned scale MUST BEAT a global-constant-scale baseline (one s for all events) on gap-MAE OOS; add persistence (prior-event s_e) as a second naive baseline if cheap. ORDERING KPIs (rank_mae/sign-acc/edge-over-persistence) reported EXPECTED-FLAT by design (monotone-invariance: a positive per-event scalar cannot move ordering -- algebraic); honest-null clause applies to them by design and that flatness IS the decoupling evidence. #386 CONTRACT: the same expected_gap function with the LABEL s_e is the trustworthy baseline #386 (Thrust B epic) measures 'excess flip risk beyond the gap' against; documented + cited. NO RETRAIN: pure computation on committed s_e + read-only retro pi + DB; STOP if any path needs a retrain. HONEST-OUTCOME: if even gap-MAE shows no win over the constant baseline, that is a reportable result and the #386 contract deliverable stands regardless. OUT OF LANE: pi re-weighting/conditioning/ordering (#375); sigma-floor/tail + disagreement_rate (#388/#389); retro re-solve.
